tools.name: document-formats_en16931-invoice-validate
tools.description: Validate UBL or CII e-invoices against CEN EN 16931 artefacts 1.3.17 (and UBL 2.1 XSD). Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/document-formats/en16931-invoice-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: document-formats_fhir-resource-validate
tools.description: Validate a FHIR resource against the official HL7 JSON Schema for R4 or R5. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/document-formats/fhir-resource-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: document-formats_mrz-parse-checkdigits
tools.description: Parse TD1/TD2/TD3 machine-readable zones and verify ICAO Doc 9303 check digits. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/document-formats/mrz-parse-checkdigits. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: document-formats_epc-swiss-qr-bill-parse
tools.description: Parse SEPA EPC069-12 or Swiss QR-bill SPC text into structured payment fields. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/document-formats/epc-swiss-qr-bill-parse. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: document-formats_pdf-table-extract
tools.description: Extract bordered or whitespace-aligned tables from a caller-supplied PDF (no OCR). Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/document-formats/pdf-table-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: document-formats_barcode-decode
tools.description: Decode 1D/2D barcodes (QR, Data Matrix, PDF417, Code 128, EAN, …) from a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/document-formats/barcode-decode. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "document-formats" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: document-formats_mrz-parse-checkdigits · Private data: document-formats_en16931-invoice-validate, document-formats_fhir-resource-validate, document-formats_mrz-parse-checkdigits, document-formats_epc-swiss-qr-bill-parse, document-formats_pdf-table-extract, document-formats_barcode-decode · Public sink: document-formats_en16931-invoice-validate, document-formats_fhir-resource-validate, document-formats_mrz-parse-checkdigits, document-formats_epc-swiss-qr-bill-parse, document-formats_pdf-table-extract, document-formats_barcode-decode · Destructive: document-formats_en16931-invoice-validate, document-formats_fhir-resource-validate, document-formats_mrz-parse-checkdigits, document-formats_epc-swiss-qr-bill-parse, document-formats_pdf-table-extract, document-formats_barcode-decode.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
